description: NaPaO₃ is (Cubic) Perovskite structured and crystallizes in the cubic Pm̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to twelve equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent PaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 3.06 Å. Pa⁵⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form PaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PaO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Pa-O bond lengths are 2.16 Å. O²⁻ is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Pa⁵⁺ atoms.
